snippet.title: Xenogears (PS1) - Full Game Walkthrough - No Commentary - Longplay - Gameplay - Part 1
snippet.description:
Xenogears! Part 1 of 3! When I was a child I watched my dad play this game. I thought this game was the coolest! (With the mechs and shit lol). Now that I think about it I don't think my dad has ever beaten this game :O
After playing through Xenogears I didn't know what to expect!

00:43:10 to 00:51:09 Audio Issues :(((( I don't know what happened to the audio. I'm sorry :(

Enjoy!
